payload.title: Qualify Windows operations, recovery and privacy
payload.goal: OPO runs independently with bounded failure handling and a portable optional R730 handoff.
payload.owner_role: OPO dedicated Windows release owner / admitted implementation lane
implementation_steps: Configure temporary independent Windows execution with host-local secrets/store, mission service identity, process-tree timeout/cleanup and finite retry/repair classes; no worker or inherited schedule modification without recorded handoff.

Back up state/receipt manifests with retention and secret exclusion; restore into isolated rehearsal, fence old owner and reconcile unknown effects before enabling writes. Add actionable alerts for failed delivery, store unavailability, spend exhaustion and privacy incidents with one deduplicated escalation.

Exercise optional R730 migration only after shared target qualification: export sanitized state version, inject host-local secret references, verify destination ownership and controlled cutover. Keep Windows useful without migration and keep i9 deferred.
tests: Kill a parent with child/grandchild and held pipes: Windows cleanup finishes within configured bound with no surviving mission process.
Restore latest backup with an in-flight reply/refund; one owner reconciles it and excludes secrets from portable artifacts.
Pause/resume, storage outage and Mac-disconnected interval preserve useful operation; no unchanged alert repeats.

review.identity_requirement: A reviewer other than the implementer records actual identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model review when required by the admitted contract. Self-review does not qualify.
review.source_binding: Review exact Git commit and SHA256 manifest of changed source/assets/config; distinguish Windows CRLF worktree bytes from Git blobs. Any repair invalidates affected prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two repair/review attempts per candidate within admitted budget; unresolved failure creates one actionable block and leaves independent work eligible.

acceptance: Windows start/restart/restore/stop has evidence, bounded failure and actionable alerting.
Optional R730 acceptance proves fenced takeover; migration is neither claimed nor a release prerequisite.
payload.rollback: Disable this capability, retain immutable evidence/receipts, restore the last reviewed source/config version and reconcile attempted external effects before any retry.
payload.next_eligible_action: Designated owner matches the proposed scope to current Jira/source and assigns disjoint paths; then perform implementation step 1. External gates block only the named effects.

estimate.assumptions: New planning estimate, not historical estimate or worklog. Reuse accepted returned implementation where its exact source passes this contract. Excludes elapsed observation windows, account waiting and shared SH implementation.
estimate.dependency_risk: Host/provider/account qualification or conflicting release-worker ownership can delay dependent effects; offline work remains eligible.

conditional_dependencies.condition: Optional R730 migration or host transfer only; independent Windows recovery and runtime acceptance do not depend on migration.
conditional_dependencies.acceptance: Before target cutover qualify target host/storage, fence old owner, reconcile uncertain effects, inject target-local secret references and verify equivalent receipts/rollback. If target unavailable, complete Windows acceptance and retain migration pending.
